title: Part Six: Blackstone, Balfour and the 1940s Committees

sections.brief: William E. Blackstone (Jesus Is Coming 1878; Chicago Hebrew Mission; 1890 conference); the memorial of 5 March 1891 (text, request for an international conference, 413 or 431 signers, Harrison's response); the 1916 memorial, Straus and Brandeis letters, Presbyterian endorsement, disputed presentation to Wilson; conversion aim stated beside the restoration aim. Figures: time; compare

Balfour and Lloyd George: the Christian-formation thesis (Alexander, Lewis; Lloyd George's Baptist upbringing per Kessler) set beside the War Cabinet's stated reasons, Balfour's 'propaganda' minute, Cecil, Schneer, Lloyd George's own 1937 Peel testimony and Montagu; Orde Wingate (Plymouth Brethren upbringing, Special Night Squads, Segev vs Oren, recall 1939, death 1944). Figures: compare; time

American Palestine Committee (Neumann 1932, revived 1941, Wagner) and Christian Council on Palestine (founding minutes 14 Dec 1942: Atkinson, Niebuhr, Neumann present; 'autonomous' vs Grose 'hardly autonomous'; $150,000 reported); ACPC 1946 and its wind-down (dates disputed); who joined (mainline clergy, not dispensationalists; Norris as fundamentalist counterpart); Gildersleeve opposition; Truman 'I am Cyrus' (1953, as reported) with Merkley vs Judis; Goldman, Hummel, Spector. Figures: stats; compare; time
